summary: Generational-handle object pool over a caller-provided byte array. v1 packs a generation into every handle but never advances it on free and never compares it on lookup, so a stale handle silently resolves to the slot's next owner (index-based use-after-free, CWE-416); v2 bumps the generation in the release path and validates it on every lookup; v3 is a behaviour-preserving refactor of v2.

pairs.intent: CWE-416 fix: hp_release_slot advances the slot generation (new helper hp_next_gen, which skips 0) and hp_slot_for rejects a handle whose generation differs from the slot's; the raw-index accessor hp_get_unchecked is removed. Every public handle operation is text-identical and inherits the fix through hp_slot_for.
